info.name: LegalDeadline Flow - Backend learning and RF demonstration
info.description: Run all folders in order. Uses synthetic per-run records; finalizes its own cases/tasks/deadlines and deactivates its own two users. Existing demo accounts are not edited. RF01–RF18 API examples; RF19 restart/idempotence and complete boundary evidence are documented in backend-learning-and-demo-guide.en.md. Spanish API names are preserved. Requires demo administrator/supervisor/auditor accounts.

04.02 Two days plus active tasks means critical

exec: pm.test("A has two active tasks", function () { pm.expect(b.find(x=>x.responsableId === Number(pm.environment.get('a_id'))).tareasActivas).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("B is present with zero tasks", function () { pm.expect(b.find(x=>x.responsableId === Number(pm.environment.get('b_id'))).tareasActivas).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Two active tasks added", function () { pm.expect(b.tareasActivas - Number(pm.environment.get('baseline_active'))).to.eql(2); });
